"""Run a real corrected lesson kernel and save its exact input/output evidence."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
lesson = sys.argv[1]
if not lesson.replace('.', '').isalnum():
    raise ValueError('Invalid lesson ID')
os.chdir(root)
env = os.environ | {'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS': '1'}
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/build_course.py'], env=env, check=True)
matches = [p for p in (root / 'notebooks').rglob('*.ipynb') if p.stem == lesson]
if len(matches) != 1:
    raise ValueError(f'Expected one notebook for {lesson}, found {len(matches)}')
original = matches[0]
output_root = root / 'outputs/notebooks-reader-round'
result_path = output_root / 'validation-kernel.json'
result_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
input_sha = sha(original)
started_at = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
command = ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/check_notebooks.py', '--mode', 'kernel', '--workers', '1', '--output', 'outputs/notebooks-reader-round', '--lesson', lesson]
subprocess.run(command, env=env, check=True)
result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
assert result['mode'] == 'kernel' and result['total'] == result['passed'] == 1 and result['failed'] == 0 and not result['failures']
assert sha(original) == input_sha, 'Original notebook changed during execution'
executed = output_root / original.relative_to(root / 'notebooks')
a = json.loads(original.read_text()); b = json.loads(executed.read_text())
assert len(a['cells']) == len(b['cells'])
code_count = output_count = 0
for ca, cb in zip(a['cells'], b['cells'], strict=True):
    assert ca['cell_type'] == cb['cell_type'] and ca['source'] == cb['source']
    if ca['cell_type'] == 'code':
        code_count += 1
        assert cb['execution_count'] is not None
        assert all(o['output_type'] != 'error' for o in cb['outputs'])
        output_count += len(cb['outputs'])
receipt = {
    'schema_version': 1, 'started_at': started_at,
    'checked_at': datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'Actual fresh CPU kernel rerun of this corrected notebook. All current cell sources match, every code cell has an execution count, and there are no error outputs. This records execution, not a reader or factual review verdict.',
    'command': command, 'environment': {'python': platform.python_version(), 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS': '1'},
    'result': result, 'notebook': str(original.relative_to(root)),
    'input_sha256': input_sha, 'executed_sha256': sha(executed),
    'code_cells': code_count, 'output_blocks': output_count,
    'verification_program': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
target = root / f'docs/validation-artifacts/technical-revision-{lesson}-kernel.json'
if target.exists():
    old = target.read_bytes()
    if json.loads(old).get('input_sha256') != input_sha:
        history = target.parent / 'kernel-revision-history'
        history.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (history / f'{lesson}-{hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()[:16]}.json').write_bytes(old)
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'receipt': str(target.relative_to(root)), 'lesson': lesson, 'passed': True, 'code_cells': code_count, 'seconds': result['seconds']}))
